description_en: After a workgroup is created, you can view its information, such as the workgroup name, description, and alert information
description_zh: 创建工作组后，您可以查看工作组的相关信息，包括工作组名称、工作组描述、告警信息等
kebab_example: aliyun smc describe-workgroups --workgroup-id w-bp10geepnj916e3d0000 --name test --status InProgress --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWorkgroups

parameters.help_en: A list of workgroup IDs. You can specify up to 50 workgroup IDs
parameters.help_zh: 工作组ID列表，最多可以输入50个工作组ID
parameters.name: workgroup_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the workgroup. Valid values:

NotStarted: The workgroup is not started.

InProgress: The workgroup is in progress.

Cutover: The workgroup is being cut over.

Completed: The workgroup is completed
parameters.help_zh:
工作组的状态。取值范围：

NotStarted：未开始。
InProgress：进行中。
Cutover：割接中。
Completed：已完成
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the workgroup list. The value starts from 1.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
工作组列表的页码。起始值：1。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The tag key of the workgroup. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 工作组的标签键。最多支持 128 个字符，一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the workgroup. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string. The value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 工作组的标签值。最多支持 128 个字符，一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The array of tags. The array can contain 1 to 20 tags. If the array contains multiple tag objects, the tag keys cannot be the same
parameters.help_zh: 标签数组。数组长度：1~20。如果数组中有多个标签对象，标签键 Key 不允许重复
parameters.name: tag
